identificationModule.briefTitle: A IB/II Phase Clinical Study on the Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of SHR-9839(sc) in Combination Anti-tumor Therapy in Patients With Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Multicenter Phase IB/II Clinical Study on the Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of SHR-9839(sc) in Combination Anti-tumor Therapy in Patients With Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is an open-label, multi-center Phase IB/II clinical trial of SHR-9839(sc) combined with anti-tumor therapy in patients with advanced solid tumors, aimed at evaluating the safety, tolerability, and efficacy of SHR-9839(sc) in combination with anti-tumor therapy in patients with advanced solid tumors.
